transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, this is Meera calling from Niva Bupa. I'm reaching out to see if I can share some health insurance options. Is now a good time to talk?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great! Who are you looking to cover today and how many people would that be?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: That's for me and my brother, we are in Delhi.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Got it. Could you tell me the age of the older sibling?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Understood. Do you or your brother have any pre-existing health conditions?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: What's the waiting period if I already have diabetes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: For diabetes, the waiting period can be up to 36 months before related treatment is covered. Shall I see what that means for your age and plan?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: When is my next premium due?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A colleague will call you shortly to help with that.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Have a great day.
